kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
استشهدا (form X)
# اِسْتَشْهَدَا (istašhadā) /is.taʃ.ha.daː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# اُسْتُشْهِدَا (ustušhidā) /us.tuʃ.hi.daː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
# اِسْتَشْهِدَا (istašhidā) /is.taʃ.hi.daː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
